geometry.placement_rule: two-source pair on the grid centre row, symmetric about the grid centre column (refinement-invariant; supersedes the inherited fixed col_a=1)
geometry.refinement_rule: d=3 (pre-registered, §8-iii) pinned to the array's along-axis station spacing; pole spacing = that / 3 (image-grid oversampling x3). Extents preserved to within one cell; station array unchanged.

b3_reading.source_note: B3 was run at d=3 (run_experiment_B.py D_B3=3, incoherent pair); the S8-vii procedure reads it as-is. See SPEC S.14 P1.
b3_reading.khat_clip_note: At 5 dB, MDL K-hat = 6 (= K_MAX clip) on 50/50 trials for n_snap in {8,16,32,64}; K-hat = 2 on 50/50 at 128. n_snap=64 < 75 channels makes the sample CSM rank-deficient; the raw MDL argmin falls near the rank boundary and is clipped to 6. The 64-snapshot row is retained as the intentionally overspecified B6a test; the 128-snapshot comparison is a separate descriptive under-specified row (SPEC S.14).
